provider.name: Bryozoa.net
provider.organization_type: specialist bryozoan taxonomy, biology, morphology, paleontology, bibliography, and image resource
provider.description: Bryozoa.net is a specialist web resource focused on Bryozoa, including classification, taxonomy, morphology, anatomy, identification, fossil and recent taxa, ecology, distribution, images, bibliographic references, collections, and the bryozoological research community.
institutional_context: Museums, universities, and specialist taxonomic collections

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting Bryozoa.net documentation, taxonomic and morphological guidance, identification resources, fossil and recent taxon information, images, bibliographies, legal pages, and community context.
purpose.authoritative_notice: Bryozoa.net and its identified editors or contributing institutions remain authoritative for its taxonomic content, images, bibliographies, citation guidance, legal terms, and contacts.

notes: Verify whether Bryozoa.net exposes any supported API, downloadable taxonomic list, or machine-readable service.
Do not infer undocumented endpoints from page URLs or browser behavior.
Capture parameters, identifiers, response formats, limits, update cadence, and legal conditions only when explicitly documented.
Capture exact official legal wording before normalizing rights metadata.
Separate taxonomic facts, editorial text, bibliographic compilations, photographs, illustrations, and third-party collection data.
Record image-level creators, institutions, copyright notices, and permission requirements independently.
Do not assume website availability implies unrestricted bulk reuse.
Seed URLs are best-effort and were not live-verified in this session.
The acquisition program should update retrieval, content, review, and verification fields in place.
Some legacy HTML paths may redirect, be renamed, be absent, or use different capitalization; preserve redirect and failure metadata.
Do not recursively crawl every genus, species, fossil taxon, image, bibliography entry, or researcher page when the task is documentation acquisition.
Do not store API keys, passwords, cookies, OAuth tokens, or session credentials in this JSON file.
Taxonomic facts, editorial descriptions, bibliographies, images, identification keys, and third-party collection data may carry different rights.
